action_rows.official_contract: Raft snapshot save/restore and official CLI behavior; ordinary standby forwarding under the declared valid archive contract.
action_rows.current_boundary: R10 strict wire records default native standby redirect differences. Actual old Phase B B01 leader save returned 503 and CLI exit 2, with outcome unknown and no valid archive. Diagnostic 3cb adds bounded observation only, not a behavioral fix. Its exact normal build now passed the original 44 and separate 7 tests, and the independent canonical desktop source import plus three-artifact transfer are complete. The new Phase B local stage, readonly prepare and product run have not yet been executed.
action_rows.required_work: Use the one fresh authorized diagnostic qualification after normal build to identify the admission failure. Implement any actual fix with the original one-use ownership, deadline, negative audit and unsettled fence intact. Separately implement reviewed streaming relay custody; never treat 307, CLI exit 0 or synthetic Final as archive restore proof.
action_rows.qa_gap: Bounded69 has no snapshot/CLI case. Preserve the original unknown; new valid archives A/B, two versions, API readback and cold restart are required by the separate Phase B contract.

action_rows.official_contract: JWT/OIDC and Kubernetes are actual default registry entries; SystemBackend registers login MFA. Native identity, password policy and refresh/revocation semantics must survive cold recovery.
action_rows.current_boundary: Auth::native_v6_storage_profile requires identity_mfa=None and empty password-policy/JWT/Kubernetes/OIDC state; root auth mounts are limited to token/AppRole/cert/userpass, admitted child mounts to token/AppRole/cert. Activation/restore checks reject unsupported live owners; the native dispatcher rejects unowned requests.
action_rows.required_work: Add actual typed native state and operation owners, cold codecs, revocation/renewal and current identity binding before widening any allowlist. Keep unsupported original stores intact until migration is proven.
action_rows.qa_gap: 69 covers AppRole3, userpass1, token10 and identity6 only. It does not prove JWT/OIDC, Kubernetes renewal or MFA. Existing non-native source modules or historical profile names do not qualify the native consumer.

action_rows.official_contract: Default registry includes database plugins, Kubernetes and RabbitMQ secret backends; provider-side creation, rotation, revoke and renewal are externally observable effects.
action_rows.current_boundary: require_native_storage_state rejects nonempty database state. Native EngineState admits only KV1/KV2, local Transit, TOTP, SSH and local PKI, and requires SDK catalog/owners/leases/external_keys empty. Generic audited external-effect code exists but is not admission for these native owners.
action_rows.required_work: Implement a durable native external-effect owner and reconciliation contract for each admitted backend, including unknown provider result and lease retirement. Bring actual provider fixtures and migration/cold tests; do not remove the profile guard to reuse flat-state dispatch.
action_rows.qa_gap: No database, RabbitMQ or Kubernetes case in bounded69. Actual provider tests must be distinct from plugin transport or fake-provider tests.

action_rows.official_contract: Official 2.7.1 has PKI ACME/EAB and external key APIs; existing 2.7 admission file explicitly requires external KMS/HSM and ACME hostile cases.
action_rows.current_boundary: Pki::native_local_profile requires no external signer/history and default ACME state; native_local_route excludes ACME/EAB and KMS key-generation selectors. Native Transit excludes external state. An existing generic plugin/KMS bridge is a different scope.
action_rows.required_work: Add typed native ACME and external-key ownership with provider admission, audit, durable request/result custody and no unknown replay. Preserve local-only behavior and prove the exact external contract independently.
action_rows.qa_gap: 69 PKI12 and Transit10 cases are local. They are not ACME/EAB, external signer, HSM, PQC or all route parity.

action_rows.official_contract: Actual official SystemBackend registers rekey, rotate, generate-root and namespace seal paths; raw storage is conditional on rawEnabled.
action_rows.current_boundary: Native service explicitly refuses rekey/raw and unowned system routes. Activation requires no pending rekey/recovery. Generic wrapper unseal/migration and PGP rekey backup have separate 501 refusals.
action_rows.required_work: Implement typed native lifecycle owners and key/epoch transitions with fail-closed mandatory audit and cold recovery. Explicitly define rawEnabled parity instead of making raw data access generally available.
action_rows.qa_gap: 69 has init-status1 and seal-status1; no rekey, root generation, key rotation or namespace seal completion.

action_rows.official_contract: Official SystemBackend includes plugin catalog CRUD and reload, with root namespace and command path restrictions.
action_rows.current_boundary: service_plugin returns 501 for catalog mutations and refuses generic write-capable plugin operations without durable external-effect reconciliation. Native Auth and EngineState also require plugin/SDK owners absent.
action_rows.required_work: Preserve command path/root-only security constraints while adding real registered plugin lifecycle and native durable ownership. Startup metadata, checksum pinning, wrappers and transport tests are not catalog CRUD or provider semantics.
action_rows.qa_gap: No plugin case in bounded69; historical external plugin profile labels are inventory of scoped work, not whole-surface admission.

action_rows.official_contract: Official SystemBackend registers namespace seals/tree, workflow, quotas, MFA and conditional Raft administration; 2.7 admission adds control groups and indexed consistency.
action_rows.current_boundary: Current native namespace profile rejects protected namespace custody and namespace leases. Native control groups deliberately constrain operation owners. require_native_storage_state demands default raft_admin state, so prior nondefault management policy is not generally migrated.
action_rows.required_work: Add the missing protected-namespace/admin/workflow operation owners and paired state migration; preserve real namespace incarnation, policy cache, finite actor and approval semantics.
action_rows.qa_gap: Actual HA128/Direct98 qualify their original physical failure scenarios, not every admin operation, namespace sealing, workflow or complete upgrade surface.

action_rows.official_contract: The exact 2.7.1 distribution includes CLI/Agent/Proxy, storage adapters, packaging defaults and separate 2.7 security/correctness changes, beyond core API families.
action_rows.current_boundary: The historical 59 corpus is 2.6.2; the 2.7 admission supplement explicitly says it is structural and non-exhaustive. Wrapper/tooling and KV-only migration paths do not prove full asset migration or all 2.7 behaviors.
action_rows.required_work: Create an explicit 2.7.1 route/operation/backend/tooling denominator from exact upstream source and the finite installed-consumer scope, map each to actual current-candidate evidence, and keep deployment-specific migration separate from universal compatibility.
action_rows.qa_gap: Bounded69 explicitly excludes other backends, persistent restart, HA, migration, upgrade, agent/proxy/CLI and production security. Other tests exist, but cannot be inferred from these 69.

do_not_invent_gates.subject: sys/replication*
do_not_invent_gates.finding: Native refusal alone is not proof of missing mandatory official behavior. Exact official source lists replication/status as an unauthenticated special path, but this audit has not established a registered operational replication backend. Keep unresolved/conditional, not an automatic new product requirement.

do_not_invent_gates.subject: sys/migrate
do_not_invent_gates.finding: Official operator migrate directly instantiates physical source/destination backends and copies encrypted data; a native sys/migrate refusal is not a substitute for checking that CLI contract or proof that this HTTP route is required.

do_not_invent_gates.subject: LDAP/RADIUS/Kerberos/OpenLDAP
do_not_invent_gates.finding: Present in old59 scope but absent from the exact default builtin plugin registry. May be an explicitly configured external-plugin or historical project requirement; do not count as default2.7.1 builtins from UI/client helper names alone.

do_not_invent_gates.subject: SSH
do_not_invent_gates.finding: Current native EngineState explicitly admits SSH; a real typed native SSH owner and OTP lease methods exist. Do not reuse superseded old unsupported-SSH expectations as current gaps.
